ruleset.name: ntdst-core
ruleset.description: The fleet gate's Standard tier, as locked in netdust-wp-manager's wp-gate-harness spec: PSR-12 base, WordPress.Security and WordPress.DB sniff groups, PHPCompatibilityWP pinned to the package's floor. The full WPCS ruleset is deliberately NOT used — it was explicitly rejected fleet-wide, because its formatting opinions bury the two groups that actually catch bugs.
